title: Needs you
how: Only what is open for you, oldest first. Each item says what to do, links everything it needs, and gives my recommendation. It leaves this page once you have answered it here or done it.
Pick an answer under each item; a note is optional.
foot: One page, one link, kept current (his order of 2 November). The same list is kept as plain data beside it (items.json) for the advisor's checker.

sections.name: ACTION: Cancel Marvelous Designer's renewal before 26 November
why: Everything made in Marvelous is being exported to open formats on F: and the backup before the month ends.
Kiln stays the clothing route at 70% after Monday.
steps: Sign in at marvelousdesigner.com with your account
Open your account's subscription or billing page
Switch automatic renewal off (or cancel at period end)
sections.tried: Only the account holder can stop a subscription; Claude never signs in to or changes accounts (RULINGS 11 Nov).
sections.recommendation: Do it by Wed 25 Nov: the exports finish before the month ends either way.

sections.name: ACTION: Close the extra Marvelous windows, keep one
why: The export of every Marvelous project to open files waits on one working copy.
Every garment is already saved on F:, so nothing is lost by closing.
steps: Close every Marvelous Designer window (choose Don't save if asked)
sections.tried: The bridge's own starter (11:19) refuses to pick among four copies by design; a scheduled run has no computer use, and Claude does not close your Marvelous.
sections.recommendation: Do it today when you are at the PC: about two minutes.
